Container.Name: Recordhound
Container.Overview:
Music recommendations built from your own Plex library and listening history. A list to browse, never automatic downloads.
Learns from Plex (Plexamp play counts and star ratings), Last.fm, ListenBrainz and Spotify, then finds new artists through Last.fm's similar-artist data, with a clear reason for every pick. Shows artists you stream but don't own, albums missing from artists you collect, and new releases from artists you love. Artist pages have 30-second previews, discographies and links to Spotify, Apple Music and Bandcamp. Send artists to Lidarr with your quality and metadata profiles.
Needs a Plex server with a music library and a free Last.fm API key. Everything is set up on the Settings page after the first start.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: recommendations discovery music plex plexamp lastfm last.fm listenbrainz spotify lidarr artists albums
Container.Requires: A Plex Media Server with a music library and a free Last.fm API key (last.fm/api/account/create). Last.fm scrobbles, ListenBrainz, Spotify and Lidarr are optional.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the web interface. If you change it and use Spotify, set the same port in your Spotify app's redirect URI.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Used for the nightly sync time.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the app runs as. 99 is Unraid's nobody.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the app runs as. 100 is Unraid's users.
